contour_placements.Oval: Subtle cheekbone shading to maintain natural oval symmetry.
contour_placements.Round: Vertical contouring along the outer jawline and under cheekbones to slim round proportions.
contour_placements.Square: Contouring at the outer temples and jaw corners to soften strong square angles.
contour_placements.Rectangle: Contouring along the upper hairline and bottom chin boundary to visually shorten face height.
contour_placements.Heart: Contouring at the outer temples and sides of forehead to balance the narrow pointed chin.
contour_placements.Diamond: Contouring the outer cheekbones (zygomatic arch) and highlighting the chin/forehead center to soften width.
contour_placements.default: Subtle contouring under the cheekbones to define structure.

eyebrow_shapes.Oval: Softly curved arch with natural thickness (balanced arch correction)
eyebrow_shapes.Round: High arched brow (visually elongates round face shape)
eyebrow_shapes.Rectangle: Flat, horizontal brow (visually shortens long face shape)
eyebrow_shapes.Heart: Rounded, soft arch (balances pointed chin and wide forehead)
eyebrow_shapes.Diamond: Soft angled or curved arch (minimizes wide cheekbone visual width)
eyebrow_shapes.default: Softly curved arch with natural thickness
